_comment: Per-line decisions for build_new_rows.py on hadeeqat_ul_aulia, 10 October 2026 (HANDOVER 9.286). Keys are line numbers in entries/book_takeaways/hadeeqat_ul_aulia.md. 'exclude' lines become no row and are listed in the patch instructions; 'pair' lines all stay rows and are all flagged, never merged.

exclude.3524: held: entangled with the shrine-of-baba-shah-chiragh identity question (Doubt I3, a held item)
exclude.3534: held: Chiragh Shah, the same held question (Doubt I3)
exclude.3575: already an archive row: the editor equates Aziz al-Din Makki with peer-makki (Doubt B21), whose entry carries this material
exclude.3592: already an archive row by the notes' own tentative identification with darbar-malik-ahmad-ayaz (contradiction 12), whose entry carries it
exclude.3630: not a grave or shrine: the relic collections
exclude.3644: no name: the subject of entry no. 106 is unnamed in the transcription

pair: may be one person: two Ismail Muhaddiths of Lahore
may be one person: two Muhammad Taqis of the Mufti family
may be one person: two Muhammad Muqim Muhkam al-Dins of the Hujra family
the notes keep these Ghulam Muhyi al-Dins distinct (Doubt I16): do not merge

figures._comment: For build_book_figures.py. 'alsoNamedRegions': regions whose '- Also named:' list is about saints and is taken; the others are left out and reported. 'skipItems': bold runs inside a taken list that are not a figure, or not a saint. 'joins': a book figure that IS a figure the graph already holds (checked by hand against the graph's own record, 10 Oct 2026). 'hasRow': a figure listed without a place that has a [PK] line elsewhere in the same file, so it already became a proposed row and is dropped here.

skipItems.Rishis at folio 171: an index note, not a name
skipItems.Gangaram Pandit Dehlvi: a darbar official, not a saint

figures._comment_notJoined: Checked and NOT joined: Shaikh Nasir al-Din Mahmud 'Chiragh-e Dehli' is not the graph's syed-nasiruddin-mahmud (a Bukhari ancestor of Ghazi Baba, kg-seeds familyRelations).
